purpose: Authorize new source-backed customary identities beyond the frozen original 63-row French-world SOT-07 research workbook without pretending they belonged to its original rows.
governance: Original SOT-07 IDs remain immutable and are reused only for their original concepts.
Every extension requires direct ritual/source witnesses, a stable new ID, a defined lay use, and an explicit legal/historical/customary class.
Calendar owns the date and liturgical rank; the custom may explain a minister's blessing but does not implement priestly ritual.
Global Roman-rite source provenance never asserts that every church performs the custom; no map pin without place-specific proof.
Modern Book of Blessings requirements and pre-conciliar Roman Ritual requirements remain separate.

extensions.name: Assumption blessing of herbs, flowers and fruits
extensions.calendar_relation: 15 August Assumption; local blessing separate from the Missal's 1962 feast
extensions.controlling_proof: Vatican Directory §181 explicitly associates blessing of herbs with Germanic regions and the historical Roman Ritual; direct historical blessing and traditional parish practice additionally attested.
extensions.scope: Optional local priestly blessing, brought plants and domestic significance; no liturgical action instructions.

extensions.name: St John the Evangelist's wine blessing
extensions.calendar_relation: 27 December, St John the Apostle and Evangelist; fixed date, distinct from Mass rubrics
extensions.controlling_proof: Traditional parish reproduction of the 1962 Roman Ritual blessing and independent Catholic parish historical testimony.
extensions.scope: Lay awareness where available; not drinking advice or ritual text.

extensions.name: Blessing of Easter foods
extensions.calendar_relation: Holy Saturday, derived from Calendar Easter; blessed Easter foods consumed in household on Easter Day
extensions.controlling_proof: Historical Weller Roman Ritual blessings of eggs, lamb and bread; official Vatican Directory §150 and diocesan 2026 description of regional practice.
extensions.scope: Optional food blessing where offered, not a replacement for Holy Saturday and Easter services or the Easter meal prayer.

extensions.scope: Optional well-bounded household or community custom; Calendar holds date, Learn holds context and original short EN/FR guidance.
